trigger.issue: Huang Anura schema was frozen as separate Genus and Species columns, but v0.1 implementation normalized Species alone as a binomial. This produced only 9 matches and made the validation non-estimable.
trigger.reason: Primary/adult/family models were not estimable; no Huang SVL coefficient was produced.

repair.taxon_name_rule: Construct source binomial as normalized Genus + Species when Species does not already begin with Genus and contains fewer than two tokens; otherwise retain normalized Species.
repair.exact_match_order: Unchanged from v0.1: exact normalized binomial, then frozen genus alias only.
